texto: Spider-Man is a fictional superhero created by writer Stan Lee and artist Steve Ditko, first appearing in Amazing Fantasy number 15 in August 1962. The character is Peter Parker, a high school student from Queens, New York, who gains spider-like abilities after being bitten by a radioactive spider. His powers include superhuman strength, the ability to cling to surfaces, and a precognitive danger sense he calls his spider-sense. Using his scientific genius, Peter builds web-shooters that allow him to swing between buildings. After failing to stop a burglar who later kills his uncle Ben, Peter adopts the mantra that with great power comes great responsibility. He balances his life as a student and later a photographer for the Daily Bugle with his career as a crime-fighting superhero in New York City.
